decisions.reason: This aloe vera line is highly related to the firm's established natural facial-care knowledge and in-house formulation capabilities, and its continued prominent presentation suggests the firm can keep learning from demand and refine it rather than withdraw it.

The hyaluronic acid serum remains close to the firm's core skincare competence and supplier base, so absorptive capacity is strong enough for incremental improvement and continued marketing despite some moderate portfolio rationalisation risk.

The cleansing milk fits the firm's existing cleansing and gentle-care know-how, but its less prominent positioning than the strongest products makes it somewhat more exposed to pruning if sales or differentiation stay modest.

The cleansing oil is still closely related to the firm's facial-care capabilities, yet as the newest and less proven launch it carries the highest near-term exit risk while management tests whether it can absorb feedback and establish a stable place in the range.
